surface: standalone static PNG and SVG for manuscript figures
formal_input_policy: Formal figures may only use a frozen paper-v1 analysis bundle. Demo figures must carry a visible DEMO / NOT FORMAL EVIDENCE mark and use a separate output root.

palette.policy: single-root preferred; hard two-root cap except the five-slice dataset composition pie

figures.name: trust_dataflow_architecture
figures.question: Where can authority and untrusted data enter the runtime?
figures.takeaway: Untrusted content can provide data but cannot create permission; expansion is routed through independent confirmation.

figures.name: safety_utility_pareto
figures.question: Which defenses provide non-dominated security and utility?
figures.takeaway: Compare safety and task completion jointly rather than optimizing ASR alone.

figures.name: adaptive_budget_curve
figures.question: How does worst-case ASR change as the black-box query budget grows?
figures.takeaway: Static robustness must be distinguished from budgeted adaptive robustness.

figures.name: model_defense_heatmap
figures.question: Are defense effects consistent across models?
figures.takeaway: Model-specific failure pockets remain visible rather than being averaged away.

figures.name: family_language_heatmap
figures.question: Which attack-family and language combinations remain vulnerable?
figures.takeaway: Multilingual and cross-tool variation is evaluated at the cell level.

figures.name: authorization_uncertainty_curve
figures.question: How do ASR, TCR and ASK change as authorization quality degrades?
figures.takeaway: Authorization uncertainty exposes the safety-utility-confirmation trade-off.

figures.name: ablation_forest
figures.question: Which components have an independently non-zero effect?
figures.takeaway: Point estimates are shown with confidence intervals to prevent zero-contribution modules from being overstated.

figures.name: latency_ecdf
figures.question: What is the end-to-end latency distribution for each defense?
figures.takeaway: Tail behavior is reported in addition to medians.

figures.name: failure_taxonomy
figures.question: What types of failures remain under each defense?
figures.takeaway: Unsafe effects, false blocks, ASK, parse failures and timeouts stay distinct.

figures.name: dataset_composition
figures.question: What is the high-level M3-v2 case composition?
figures.takeaway: A single composition figure summarizes attacks and both benign task types.
